title: A Household Settling a Snowsports School Booking Before the Balance Falls Due
content:
A household settling ahead of the day the balance falls due is allowed a further reduction in money on a Snowsports School booking.

## When the balance falls due

The balance falls due the product's balance period in calendar days from the day the booking was recorded, the day of recording counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike.

| Product | Balance period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 0 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 0 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 0 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 30 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 14 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 14 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 45 |

## The reduction allowed

Where the handling date falls fourteen or more days short of that day, the early settlement reduction of 60.00 USD is allowed. Where the handling date falls between one and thirteen days short of it, the prompt settlement reduction of 25.00 USD is allowed. Where the balance falls due on the handling date or has already fallen due, no reduction in money is allowed, the reduction standing at 0.00 USD.

## Both sides of each boundary

Take a booking of the Six-Week Development Programme recorded on the first of a month. Its balance period is 30 calendar days, so counting the first as day zero the balance falls due on the thirty-first.

| Handling date | Days short of the due day | Reduction in money |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the tenth | 21 | 60.00 USD |
| the seventeenth | 14 | 60.00 USD |
| the eighteenth | 13 | 25.00 USD |
| the thirtieth | 1 | 25.00 USD |
| the thirty-first | none, the balance falling due that day | 0.00 USD |
| the following month | the balance has already fallen due | 0.00 USD |

On a product whose balance period is 0 calendar days, the balance falls due on the day the booking was recorded, so on any handling date from that day onward no reduction in money is allowed.
